description: Browse the anonymous Soundcheck Event Directory (directory.soundchecklive.io): list indexed cities with venue and hotel counts, optionally filter by US state or city name, or open one city page by city_key for its venue and hotel summaries. Returns public directory URLs only — no login and no Tier 2 production intel.

city.description: city display name to match when listing cities

cityKey.description: directory city_key for a city detail view (from a prior browse_directory result)

state.description: US state filter: two-letter code, state slug, or full state name

type.description: when set, only count or list that place type

name: browse_directory

data.description: tool payload (API/composite/confirmation object); object, array, or primitive JSON

title: Browse event directory by city
